extracted.name: Chilli Garlic Fries
extracted.description: At the nexus of decadence and robust flavour are chilli garlic fries. They are loud, disorganized, and incredibly fulfilling; they are not attempting to be elegant or subtle. Before you see them, you can smell them: the unmistakable comfort of freshly fried potatoes, the spicy warmth of chilli hanging in the air, and the punchy hit of garlic sizzling in oil. The point is that it's not subtle. With crunchy edges giving way to soft, fluffy cores and a coating that is equal parts salty, spicy, and little addicting, every bite offers a contrast. It's the kind of snack that can make a casual get-together unforgettable or turn a typical evening into an intense hunger session. The simplicity of emphasis is what distinguishes chilli garlic fries from other laden or seasoned fries. To make an impression, they don't use cheese pulls or thick toppings. Rather, they focus on a few strong components that are executed well: texture, heat, and scent. The garlic is prominently shown rather than being modest. The spice remains rather than merely tingling. Additionally, when combined, they produce a flavor character that is both exciting and familiar. Chilli garlic fries remain relevant in a world where culinary trends are constantly changing. They don't require innovation or the excitement surrounding it. Delivering robust taste, quick comfort, and just the proper amount of pandemonium on a plate is exactly what they're meant to do. Perhaps this is why they are always in style.
instruction_lines: In a bowl add the fries.
Add salt, paprika, 1 teaspoon of flakes, flour, egg and 3 tablespoons of water. Mix well to coat the fries.
Heat oil and deep fry the fries till golden.
Melt butter in a pan and add the garlic, flakes, ketchup, soy and chilli garlic sauce. Mix well.
Add water and cook for 10 seconds.
Add fries and toss to coat with the sauce.
Sprinkle sesame seeds and cilantro. Mix.
